# apicurio_group (Resource)

A group of artifacts. Groups are also created implicitly by the first artifact stored in them (when `apicurio.storage.enable-automatic-group-creation` is on, the default); such a group can be imported. The group `default` is implicit and cannot be managed.

Deleting a group deletes every artifact in it, which is why the resource refuses to destroy a group that still contains artifacts unless `force_destroy` is `true`. The registry must have `apicurio.rest.deletion.group.enabled=true` for the deletion to be allowed at all.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicurio_group" "payments" {
  group_id    = "payments"
  description = "Schemas of the payments domain"
  labels = {
    team = "payments"
    env  = "prod"
  }

  # Deleting the group deletes its artifacts; refuse that unless asked for.
  force_destroy = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Identifier of the group (1 to 512 characters, no `/`). `default` is reserved. Changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the group even when it still contains artifacts (they are deleted with it). Defaults to `false`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels (key/value pairs) of the group.
- `owner` (String) Owner of the group. Defaults to the user the provider authenticates as (empty on a registry without authentication). Apicurio Registry 3.0.x does not store the owner of a group; setting it there is reported as an error.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Same as `group_id`.
- `modified_by` (String) User of the last modification.
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Groups are imported by their id.
terraform import apicurio_group.payments payments
```
